description: Pak-Qatar Family Takaful Limited is a Pakistani family takaful operator, one of the companies of the Pak-Qatar Takaful Group alongside Pak-Qatar General Takaful Limited and Pak-Qatar Asset Management Company. It provides Shariah-compliant family takaful — protection and savings cover structured on takaful principles rather than conventional insurance — through its own sales force, bancassurance and corporate arrangements. Its head office is in Karachi.
headOffice: 101-105, Business Arcade, Plot 27/A, Block 6, P.E.C.H.S., Shahrah-e-Faisal, Karachi 75400, Pakistan
